effects.body: You have enough information now to make a real recommendation about strategic minerals, energy, northern logistics, and worker safety. The trade-off is not whether Meridian is good or bad; it is which failure you are most willing to risk.

responseWindow.prompt: What should Meridian prioritize first?

options.label: Prioritize speed
options.description: Accept more concentrated authority and execution risk to capture the current opportunity.

options.label: Prioritize resilience
options.description: Favor redundancy, spare capacity, and slower implementation that can absorb shocks.

options.label: Prioritize shared oversight
options.description: Favor transparent review and distributed governance even when coordination takes longer.

options.label: Prioritize local control
options.description: Keep more authority in countries and existing institutions even at a higher transaction cost.
